request.tone: warm, witty museum mystery with puzzles; violence none, scariness mild, peril moderate
request.note: catalog book; plan written blind by reading the book, no request exists

pitch.hero: Nadia, a label-reading schoolgirl locked alone overnight in the old Ellery Museum
pitch.want: to follow a torn map and the founder's recorded tour to his hidden collection
pitch.obstacle: a night guard on rounds, a coded note, a sleeping brass globe and traps that punish haste
pitch.stake: the town's lost treasures and the founder's name, falsely remembered as a thief
pitch.ending_kind: the vault found and the truth told many ways, or setbacks of haste, force or greed

nadia.name: Nadia
nadia.want: to find the founder's hidden collection before morning
nadia.voice: close third past; curious, dry, talks back to objects

ellery.name: Ambrose Ellery
ellery.role: the museum's founder, heard on his century-old recorded audio tour
ellery.want: a finder to return the town's treasures and clear his name
ellery.voice: crackling, dry, aphoristic, fond of riddles

pym.name: Mr. Pym
pym.role: the night guard of thirty-one years
pym.want: to learn where the founder's secret leads
pym.voice: kind, firm, talks to exhibits, does crosswords

tess.name: Tess
tess.want: to share the secret and keep watch

curator.name: the curator
curator.role: head of the museum, arrives at eight

truth.question: What is the founder's hidden collection, and why did he hide it?
truth.statement: Ambrose Ellery did not sell the town's treasures. When the museum owed more than it owned and creditors meant to sell everything by the pound, he hid the collection in a vault under the rotunda globe, stop 38, took the blame, and left a trail for a finder: the torn map Pym planted, a key, a shift-three code, and the rings four, nine, two.

nadia_locked_in.text: Nadia, a girl who reads every museum label, is left behind and locked alone in the old Ellery Museum at night.

doors_locked_no_signal.text: The museum's main doors are locked for the night and Nadia's phone has no signal inside.

nobody_will_miss_her.text: Nadia's mum thinks she is sleeping over at Tess's and Tess thinks she went home sick, so nobody will miss her before morning.

handset_thirteen.text: Nadia wears audio guide handset thirteen around her neck.

half_map_in_pouch.text: Someone tucked half of an old museum map, torn down the middle, into the handset's pouch.

brass_mark.text: The map carries a small brass mark, a circle crossed by two lines.

map_ringed_wing.text: A pencil ring on the map marks a wing Nadia has never seen, labelled in square letters: the founder's hidden collection, start at the mark.

night_guard_on_rounds.text: A night guard walks rounds through the museum.

lights_going_out.text: The night setting is switching the lobby lights off row by row, the green lamp over the visitors' book last.

tour_board_chalk.text: A tour board with a fat stub of yellow chalk stands in the lobby on the guard's route.

map_back_read.text: Nadia read the back of her half of the map under the lobby lamp.

map_back_unread_before.text: Nadia had never turned her half of the map over before she was shut in the roped gallery.

map_back_half_sentence.text: The back of the map holds a torn half sentence in brown ink: my east wing is not gone, for it has one door left, and that door opens only.

wedge_warning.text: A square pencil warning on the back of the map says the rope gallery door shuts itself, so wedge it, signed by someone who sat in there till the cleaners came.

board_message.text: Nadia chalked on the tour board that she is locked in, not a burglar, Nadia from class 6B, back soon.

nadia_has_chalk.text: Nadia kept the stub of chalk in her coat pocket.

no_chalk.text: Nadia has no chalk with her in the dark stacks.

rotunda_globe.text: The rotunda holds a huge brass globe of rings inside rings on a stone pedestal, tour stop one.

ellery_audio_tour.text: The audio guide plays the founder, old Ambrose Ellery, who recorded his own tour almost a hundred years ago.

globe_is_heart.text: Ellery calls the brass globe the heart of his museum and says most people look at it for four seconds.

three_archways.text: Three archways lead from the rotunda to the Gallery of Gems, the Egyptian Wing and the Archive stairs.

gems_crooked_case.text: In the Gallery of Gems a big glass case of gems sits crooked on its stand.

gems_beeping.text: A faint, steady beeping comes from somewhere past the crooked case.

someone_else_searched.text: Someone else has recently been searching the exhibits, opening cases and lids in a hurry.

tilted_vitrine_card.text: Inside the crooked case a small vitrine tilts over something and an old card lies face down behind it.

nadia_has_token.text: Nadia carries a coin-sized brass token stamped with the mark from her map.

no_token.text: Nadia has nothing coin-shaped to leave in the owl's place.

token_motto.text: The brass token reads LEAVE ME WHERE YOU TAKE around its back.

narrow_door_gems.text: A narrow door in the back wall of the Gallery of Gems, half hidden by a folded screen, opens on a corridor.

glass_ring_label.text: An old label in the founder's thin hand says the ring is glass, the real one went somewhere safer with much else, and the curious should try the corridor.

mark_on_skirting.text: At the blank end of the gems corridor the mark is scratched on a loose skirting board.

sensor_battery.text: The beeping is only a wall sensor with a tired battery.

guard_threat.text: If the night guard finds Nadia he will walk her to the lobby and the night will be over.

guard_31_years.text: The night guard has spent thirty-one years in the museum wondering about its hidden secret.

sarcophagus_crooked.text: In the Egyptian Wing the painted sarcophagus lid sits crooked, as if lifted and not set back.

old_wall_map.text: A faded wall map in the Egyptian Wing shows the museum as it was a hundred years ago, with halls Nadia has never walked.

amulet_empty_dent.text: One coin-sized dent in the amulet case's velvet sits empty.

token_of_house_card.text: A card in the amulet case says the token of the house was removed by the founder and is not far away.

hall_behind_egypt.text: A draught leads through a gap behind the sarcophagus to a bare hall.

mark_on_floor_tile.text: At the far end of the hall behind the Egyptian Wing a loose floor tile carries the mark.

ringed_wing_behind_egypt.text: The wing ringed on Nadia's map begins right behind the Egyptian room.

power_cut_torch.text: A power-cut torch hangs on a bracket by the wall map.

roped_gallery_closed.text: A red rope marked CLOSED FOR REPAIR bars a dark gallery, with cold air coming under its door.

torch_died.text: The power-cut torch's battery dies partway along the lost wing's route.

rope_gallery_arch_29.text: The roped gallery holds a huge bricked-up arch numbered 29, behind which Ellery says his east wing lies.

locked_in_gallery.text: The roped gallery door shut behind Nadia with no inside handle, and she waited there until the cleaners came at six.

archive_ledger_stacks.text: The Archive has an open visitor ledger under two lamps and deep, dark back stacks.

founder_came_to_hide.text: The founder signed the ledger's first page and wrote that he came to hide something.

sticking_drawer.text: A low cabinet's deep bottom drawer sticks fast, and something rolls inside it.

row_q_target.text: The founder's hidden thing is in Row Q, the last row of the back stacks, behind the dictionaries.

mark_on_shelf_q.text: The mark is cut into a shelf edge in Row Q, with a finger-wide gap behind the dictionaries.

grating_to_lobby.text: A grating over the back stacks opens on the lobby, so a light down there would show to the guard.

lantern_on_hook.text: A battery lantern hangs on a hook at the edge of the dark stacks.

records_for_finder.text: Four boxes of the founder's tour records, numbered 37 to 40, are labelled For the finder.

tour_has_36_stops.text: The museum's audio tour has only thirty-six stops.

brass_key_found.text: Nadia found a small brass key wrapped in oilcloth, stamped with the mark.

mark_not_found.text: Nadia never found what the mark on her map opens.

coded_note.text: A note in coded letters that spell nothing is tied to the brass key.

key_three_locks.text: At stop 37 Ellery says the key fits three locks to his rooms, the study, the glass cabinet and the back stair, each hiding a way to read the note.

founder_portrait.text: The founder's study holds a roll-top desk and a portrait of Ellery with a white beard and sharp nose, hung on a hinge.

nadia_has_glasses.text: Nadia has a pair of round reading glasses pushed up in her hair.

glasses_are_founders.text: The reading glasses Nadia keeps are the founder's own.

notebook_worked_line.text: The founder's notebook shows one line of the code with its plain meaning written beneath.

cipher_wheel.text: A safe behind the portrait holds a brass cipher wheel with two rings of letters.

reading_table_landing.text: A small reading table with a green-shaded lamp stands by the window on the landing outside the study.

cabinet_stuck_lid.text: The glass cabinet of travel journals unlocks with the key but its lid is glued nearly shut by old varnish.

guard_on_stairs.text: The night guard is coming up the main stairs, humming, with jingling keys.

ribbon_ledger.text: A slim ledger with a ribbon marking one page lies among the founder's travel journals.

ledger_code_table.text: The ledger's ribboned page is a two-column letter-swapping table, the key to a code.

shift_three.text: The code shifts every letter three places along the alphabet.

cipher_dial.text: A saucer-sized brass dial with two rings of letters is set into the wall at the head of the back stair.

stair_cupboard_chart.text: A cupboard at the foot of the back stair holds a brittle chart of two rings of letters.

lamp_lit.text: The reading table's lamp still lights, so someone has been changing the bulb.

cipher_decoded.text: The decoded note says: follow the stars to the heart of my house.

heart_is_globe.text: The heart of the house is the brass globe in the rotunda.

three_roads.text: The globe sleeps until one of three roads wakes it: the Astronomy Hall, the Map Room or the Clock Corridor.

combo_492.text: The globe's rings must be set to four, nine and two.

liar_star.text: Ellery says one of the painted stars in the Astronomy Hall is a liar.

brass_star_door.text: One star in the dome is a brass stud that opens a hidden door to a passage down toward the rotunda.

caged_walkway.text: The staff ladder leads to a caged walkway under the dome, with a door at its far end and a second ladder climbing higher.

star_globe.text: The Map Room holds a great turning floor globe of the night sky and a giant atlas.

gold_star_panel.text: Turning the globe's one gold star under the pointer opens a low panel to a passage.

atlas_museum_chart.text: A hand-drawn chart in the atlas maps the museum as a constellation, with a red route to its middle and a warning to mind the crates.

gold_star_door.text: The atlas route ends at a plain door with a tiny gold star over the handle.

clock_corridor.text: The Clock Corridor has a gear room at one end and a doorway crossed by a great swinging pendulum at the other.

master_clock_stars.text: The master clock has twelve painted stars for numbers, one gold, and setting its hands to the gold star opens a door.

pendulum_beat.text: The pendulum hangs clear of the doorway for a long moment on each far swing, on a count of three.

globe_awake.text: Entering the rotunda by a founder's road pulled a pin from the globe, and its rings are free and awake.

pedestal_tiles.text: The globe's stone pedestal is carved with small sliding square tiles.

guard_room_ajar.text: A door marked NIGHT GUARD stands ajar off the rotunda, with screens flickering inside.

worn_numbers.text: The numbers on the globe's rings are worn nearly flat and the rings slide easily past the mark.

vault_stair_opened.text: A marble slab beside the pedestal slid back to reveal a narrow stair down into the dark.

third_ring_jammed.text: Guessing by ear left the third ring caught a finger's width short of the two.

low_door_rotunda.text: A low door painted white hides in the curve of the rotunda wall, letting out a cold draught.

hidden_workshop.text: Behind the low door, stop 39 is the founder's hidden workshop of half-built brass birds and clockwork beasts.

brass_wren.text: A thumb-sized brass wren with a key in its back sits on the workshop bench.

rounds_book.text: The guard's room has a rounds book of tidy times and the same two initials going back years, a crossword and a black phone.

crossword_for_nadia.text: A crossword in the guard's room has NADIA printed on it.

quarter_to_four_rule.text: At a quarter to four each morning the globe's clockwork turns the rings itself and opens the floor if the heart is awake.

guard_is_pym.text: The night guard is Mr. Pym.

map_is_pyms.text: The torn map is the night guard Pym's, and the square pencil letters on it are his.

pym_planted_map.text: Pym put the map in handset thirteen himself a month ago, after thirty-one years of carrying it about.

pym_saw_board.text: Pym saw Nadia's chalked board, searched every room twice, and left the front doors unlocked with the kettle on.

phone_dial_tone.text: The guard's black phone has a working dial tone.

vault_stop_38.text: Under the rotunda, stop 38 is a stone room full of dusty paintings, carvings and small treasures.

treasures_belong_to_town.text: Ellery says every piece in the hidden room belongs to the town.

hid_from_sellers.text: Ellery hid the treasures from men who meant to sell them by the pound.

sealed_letter.text: A sealed letter marked To the finder waits on the vault's nearest shelf.

other_map_half.text: The other torn half of the old map lies on the vault shelf.

jewelled_owl.text: A small jewelled owl sits on the vault shelf.

letter_opened.text: Nadia opened and read the founder's sealed letter.

letter_left_unopened.text: Nadia did not open the founder's letter.

town_believes_thief.text: The town believes Ellery sold its treasures and kept the money.

museum_debts.text: The museum owed more than it owned, and its creditors wanted the collection sold.

ellery_took_blame.text: Ellery hid the collection, took the blame, and waited for the debts to die, but they outlived him.

key_in_forty.text: The letter tells the finder to key in stop forty for the whole truth.

letter_ps_tiny.text: The letter ends with a line written too small to read.

ps_bulb_changer.text: The tiny line says whoever kept the reading lamp's bulb changed has earned a look at the room.

bulb_changer_is_guard.text: Nadia reasons that the bulb changer must be the night guard.

inventory_book.text: Behind a panel at stop forty, a leather book lists every piece in the room and where in town it belongs.

ellery_not_thief.text: Ellery was not a thief; he hid the town's treasures to save them.

maps_joined.text: Nadia joined the two halves of the torn map.

map_untouched.text: Nadia did not touch the map half in the vault.

east_wing_intact.text: The whole map shows the lost east wing, bricked up inside the walls but never pulled down.

dotted_line_wing.text: A dotted line on the whole map runs from the vault to the lost wing through the back of the last shelf.

lost_wing_paintings.text: The lost wing is a long gallery under dust sheets, hung with the paintings the town thought sold and lost.

wing_photographed.text: Nadia photographed every painting in the lost wing she could reach.

map_photographed.text: Nadia photographed the whole map, the shelves and the letter and left everything in place.

founders_door_garden.text: The back of the joined map says the east wing's last door opens only from within, onto the garden, and her key fits it.

curator_at_eight.text: The curator unlocks the staff door at eight.

tess_cant_keep_secret.text: Tess has never been told a secret second in her life.

curator_shown.text: Nadia showed the curator the sealed letter and the open floor by the globe.

tess_told.text: Nadia told Tess about the room under the floor before anyone else.

clue_left_for_museum.text: Nadia left the joined map, the letter, the key and a note with the combination on the guard's desk, unsigned.

owl_hollow_trap.text: Lifting the owl reveals a coin-sized hollow stamped with the mark and sets a spring winding under the shelf.

bells_ring.text: Running off with the owl set a row of bells ringing that could not be stopped.

inventory_list.text: Nadia wrote a pencil list of everything in the room on the back of the coded note.

owl_speaks.text: With the token in the hollow, the owl's key makes it speak in Ellery's voice: believe whoever carries me.

dome_mark_picture.text: From the top of the dome the gold stars form the circle-and-lines mark.

key_lost.text: The brass key flew from Nadia's hand and fell through a grating under the pendulum.

pendulum_count_three.text: Writing under the pendulum says count to three and walk.

wing_nine_windows.text: The lost wing has nine windows on its garden side, which Nadia passes on her way to school.

wren_sings.text: The wound brass wren hops, sings three notes and bows.

vault_found_with_pym.text: Nadia and Pym opened the globe stair together and went down side by side.

treasures_returned.text: Within a month the treasures went back to the town and a plate under Ellery's portrait read NOT A THIEF.

curator_investigates.text: Nadia's anonymous hints led the curator to investigate the globe.

wing_opened_public.text: The lost wing's arch was unbricked and the town walked into its rooms.

out_by_founders_door.text: Nadia left through the founder's garden door and came back in by the front.

curator_believes_owl.text: The speaking owl convinces the curator to follow Nadia.

curator_reads_letter.text: The curator read the founder's letter aloud and the town learned Ellery had not sold its treasures.

two_keepers.text: Nadia and Tess kept the room secret together until the end of term.

museum_found_room.text: The museum found the room on its own and credited an unnamed curious visitor.

called_mum.text: Nadia phoned her mum from the guard's room and told the guard everything.

key_on_guard_desk.text: The brass key lies on the guard's desk.

curator_sees_photos.text: Nadia showed the curator her photographs and told her the way down.

curator_reads_list.text: The curator read Nadia's list and went to see the room.

nadia_told_pym.text: Nadia met Pym at the front desk and told him everything.

n_open.event: Nadia is locked alone in the Ellery Museum at night and finds half a torn map in her audio guide pouch pointing to the founder's hidden collection.

n_desk.event: The lobby lights die row by row; Nadia can read the map under the last lamp or chalk a message on the tour board.

n_desk_map.event: Under the lamp the back of the map shows a torn half sentence about the east wing and a warning to wedge the rope gallery door.

n_desk_chalk.event: Nadia chalks a not-a-burglar message on the tour board and pockets the chalk.

n_start.event: In the rotunda the founder's recorded tour introduces the brass globe as the museum's heart; three archways lead on.

a_gems1.event: The Gallery of Gems has a crooked case and a faint beeping.

a_gems_case.event: The case shows someone searched it in a hurry; a vitrine tilts and a card lies face down.

a_gems_vitrine.event: Under the vitrine Nadia finds and pockets a brass token; an arrow points to a narrow door.

a_gems_note.event: The founder's old label sends the curious to the corridor behind the gallery.

a_gems_corridor.event: The silent corridor ends in a loose skirting board scratched with the mark.

a_gems_alarm.event: The beeping is a tired sensor; the night guard's torch approaches and Nadia must hide.

a_gems_hide.event: Hidden behind the plinth, Nadia hears the guard mention thirty-one years of asking and sees a narrow door ajar.

b_egypt1.event: The Egyptian Wing has a crooked sarcophagus lid and an old wall map of the museum.

b_egypt_sarco.event: The lid has been moved and the amulet case has one empty coin-sized dent.

b_egypt_lid.event: Under the lid Nadia finds and pockets a brass token; a draught leads to a hall.

b_egypt_amulet.event: The card for the empty dent says the founder took the token of the house; an arrow points to a hall.

b_egypt_hall.event: The bare hall ends at a rocking floor tile cut with the mark.

b_egypt_map.event: The wall map shows the ringed wing begins behind this room; a torch hangs nearby and a roped gallery is closed for repair.

b_egypt_torch.event: Nadia follows the lost wing's route by torch until its battery dies.

b_egypt_wedge.event: Heeding the warning, Nadia wedges the gallery door, finds the bricked arch 29 to the east wing, and leaves by a side door.

c_archive1.event: The Archive offers an open visitor ledger and dark back stacks.

c_archive_ledger.event: The ledger's first page shows the founder came to hide something; a card index and a sticking drawer wait.

c_archive_index.event: A card stamped with the mark sends Nadia to Row Q behind the dictionaries.

c_archive_drawer.event: The drawer yields a brass token and a plan ringing a shelf in Row Q.

c_archive_stack.event: In Row Q a shelf cut with the mark hides a gap behind the dictionaries.

c_archive_dark.event: In the dark stacks a lantern hangs on a hook but a grating would show its light to the guard.

c_archive_lantern.event: The lantern goes unnoticed and lights the way to the last row.

c_archive_chalk.event: Chalking arrows in the dark, Nadia finds the founder's records 37 to 40 for the finder and reaches Row Q.

n_key.event: Nadia finds the brass key with a coded note; stop 37 tells her it opens three locks to the founder's rooms.

k_founder.event: The founder's study holds a roll-top desk and a hinged portrait of Ellery.

k_founder_desk.event: In the desk Nadia finds the founder's notebook with a worked line of code and his reading glasses, which she keeps.

k_founder_portrait.event: Behind the portrait an open safe holds a brass cipher wheel.

k_display.event: The key opens the glass cabinet but its lid is stuck, and the guard is coming up the stairs.

k_display_open.event: Rocking the lid patiently, Nadia frees it as the guard turns away and finds a ribboned ledger.

k_cabinet.event: The ledger's marked page is a shift-three letter table that matches the note.

k_display_force.event: Shoving the lid makes the glass creak and the guard calls out; the ledger is almost in reach.

k_display_careful.event: Nadia waits out the guard, frees the lid gently, takes the shift-three ledger to the lit reading table and unties the note.

k_stairs.event: The key opens the back stair; a cupboard at its foot hangs open.

k_stairs_up.event: At the top of the back stair a brass dial shows each letter shifts three places.

k_stairs_base.event: The cupboard holds a chart of letter rings and round glasses that reveal the shift-three instruction; Nadia keeps the glasses.

k_study.event: At the reading table the lamp still lights and Nadia flattens the coded note.

n_cipher.event: Nadia decodes the note: follow the stars to the globe, wake it by one of three roads, and set its rings to four, nine, two.

ci_stars.event: In the Astronomy Hall Ellery says one painted star is a liar; a spiral stair and a staff ladder lead up.

ci_stars_dome.event: From the spiral stair Nadia finds the brass liar star and it opens a passage toward the rotunda.

ci_stars_ladder.event: The staff ladder reaches a caged walkway with a door, and a second ladder climbs into the dark dome.

ci_stars_cross.event: Crossing the walkway, Nadia spots the brass liar star and opens the door to a stair down.

ci_map.event: The Map Room holds a turning globe of the night sky and a giant atlas.

ci_map_globe.event: Turning the globe's gold star to the pointer opens a low panel to a passage.

ci_map_atlas.event: The atlas holds a hand-drawn star chart of the museum with a red route to its middle.

ci_atlas2.event: The red route leads through a crate store to a door with a gold star.

ci_clock.event: The Clock Corridor offers a gear room or a doorway crossed by a great pendulum.

ci_clock_gears.event: Setting the master clock's hands to its gold star opens a narrow door.

ci_clock_pendulum.event: The pendulum hangs clear on each far swing; Nadia counts the beat.

ci_clock_cross.event: Walking on the beat, Nadia passes the pendulum safely to a sloping passage.

n_rotunda.event: Arriving by a founder's road wakes the globe; its pedestal is tiled and the night guard's room stands ajar.

ro_align.event: The worn, eager rings make setting four, nine, two tricky.

ro_align_set.event: Checking each number twice, Nadia sets the rings and a hidden stair opens.

ro_align_guess.event: Guessing by ear fails and the third ring jams just short of the two.

ro_align_retry.event: Nadia frees the ring, reads four, nine, two off the note and opens the stair.

ro_panel.event: The pedestal tiles slide, and a draught leads to a low hidden door in the rotunda wall.

ro_panel_solve.event: Sliding the tiles into the circle-and-lines mark opens the hidden stair.

ro_panel_secret.event: The low door opens on a dusty room of half-built brass things, numbered 39.

ro_workshop.event: Stop 39 is the founder's hidden workshop; a brass wren waits to be wound.

ro_records.event: The guard's room holds a rounds book, a crossword and a black phone, but no guard.

ro_records_guard.event: The rounds book's first page gives the founder's quarter-to-four rule; it is sixteen minutes to four and the floor opens.

ro_records_note.event: Pym's crossword note shows he saw her board, left the doors open, and that the map is his.

ro_pym.event: At the front desk Pym sees the brass key he hunted for thirty-one years, and Nadia tells him everything.

ro_records_phone.event: The phone has a dial tone; home is one call away, and the globe waits.

n_vault.event: Stop 38 is the vault of town treasures Ellery hid from sellers, with a sealed letter, the other map half and a jewelled owl.

v_letter.event: The letter explains Ellery hid the treasures from creditors and took the blame, and tells the finder to key in forty.

v_letter_ps.event: Through the founder's glasses the tiny line says the bulb changer has earned a look; Nadia thinks of the guard.

v_letter_reveal.event: Stop forty guides Nadia to a hidden leather book listing every piece and where in town it belongs.

v_reveal2.event: Reading the book to the end, Nadia sees the thief the town remembered was a man keeping its treasures safe.

v_letter_keep.event: Nadia keeps the letter, leaves everything as it was and closes the floor to make a plan.

v_map.event: The joined map shows the lost east wing still inside the walls, reachable by a dotted line from the vault.

v_map_follow.event: Through the last shelf Nadia finds the lost wing full of the town's paintings and photographs them.

v_map_photo.event: Nadia photographs the map, shelves and letter and leaves everything untouched.

v_map_back.event: The joined back completes the founder's sentence: the wing's last door opens from within onto the garden, and her key fits it.

v_share.event: Back in the rotunda Nadia weighs the curator at eight, Tess, or leaving it for the museum.

v_share_curator.event: Nadia shows the curator the sealed letter and the open floor by the globe.

v_share_secret.event: Nadia slips out to Tess's house and tells her first, asking her to keep watch.

v_share_museum.event: Nadia leaves the joined map, the letter, the key and the combination on the guard's desk, unsigned.

v_grab.event: Lifting the jewelled owl reveals a coin-sized hollow with the mark and sets a spring winding.

v_grab_run.event: Nadia runs with the owl and, having nothing coin-shaped to leave, sets the bells ringing.

v_grab_return.event: Nadia returns the owl, the spring stops, and she lists the room on the back of the coded note.

v_grab_swap.event: Nadia leaves the token in the hollow; the owl speaks in Ellery's voice to vouch for its carrier.

e_set_alarm.event: The guard Pym spots Nadia among the busts; he planted the map himself and asks where she would have looked.

e_set_locked_gallery.event: Shut in the roped gallery, Nadia reads the map's back for the first time, finds the wedge warning, and waits for the cleaners.

e_set_stuck_dark.event: Lost in the dark stacks all night, Nadia sees at dawn she sat ten steps from the mark and the records for the finder.

e_set_broken_case.event: The glass cracks, the guard catches Nadia with the code ledger, and he asks what it unlocks.

e_set_stuck_dome.event: High in the dome Nadia sees the stars form the mark, and the guard talks her down the ladder.

e_set_pendulum.event: The pendulum bumps Nadia down and her key falls through a grating; under the disc it says count to three and walk.

e_set_jammed_globe.event: The forced ring jams the globe; at a quarter to four the clockwork strains, opens a crack, and gives up.

e_set_caught.event: The bells bring the guard; he takes the owl down to where it belongs while Nadia waits for her mother.

e_set_dawn.event: Tracing the map until dawn, Nadia must slip out, then counts the lost wing's nine windows from the street.

e_win_secret_workshop.event: The wound wren sings and bows, and Nadia waits for the curator with living proof of the workshop.

e_win_night_guard.event: Nadia and the old guard open the globe stair together and argue about who tells the curator.

e_win_mystery_solved.event: Nadia carries the letter and book into the morning; the treasures return and Ellery's plate reads NOT A THIEF.

e_win_quiet_keeper.event: Over weeks Nadia nudges the curator with anonymous hints until she finds her kneeling by the globe.

e_win_lost_wing.event: Nadia's photographs bring experts, the old arch is unbricked, and the town walks into the lost wing.

e_win_founders_door.event: Nadia walks the lost wing, leaves by the founder's garden door, and returns by the front to see the curator.

e_win_owl_witness.event: The speaking owl convinces the doubting curator to follow Nadia below.

e_win_hero_curator.event: The curator goes down, reads the letter aloud, and the town learns Ellery did not sell its treasures.

e_win_secret_kept.event: Nadia and Tess revisit the stair and keep the room secret until term's end.

e_win_donate.event: The museum finds the room on its own and credits an unnamed visitor; the night guard winks at Nadia.

e_neutral_call_home.event: Nadia phones her mum and tells the curious guard everything while she waits.

e_neutral_evidence.event: Nadia slips out with the map on her phone and shows the curator the photographs and the way down.

e_neutral_wiser.event: With the letter unopened and the map untouched, Nadia hands the curator her list, and the curator goes to look.

payoff_sites.shows: having read the warning, Nadia wedges the self-shutting gallery door and sees arch 29
the joined back finishes the founder's sentence and opens the garden-door ending
the kept chalk marks a trail through the dark stacks to Row Q
the chalked board led Pym to leave Nadia a note and the doors open
leaving the token where she takes the owl stops the trap and makes the owl speak
the founder's glasses read the letter's tiny postscript about the bulb changer

e_set_alarm.gift: Pym reveals he planted the map, and the reader learns hiding beats bluffing

e_set_locked_gallery.gift: the unread warning on the map's back, and the lesson to read everything first

e_set_stuck_dark.gift: the finder's records ten steps away, and a hint that chalk would have led the way

e_set_broken_case.gift: the guard learns of the code ledger, and patience would have kept the glass whole

e_set_stuck_dome.gift: a view of the mark drawn in stars and a guard who holds the ladder

e_set_pendulum.gift: the hidden instruction to count to three and walk

e_set_jammed_globe.gift: a glimpse of the stair and the quarter-to-four clockwork, lost to force

e_set_caught.gift: the owl's trap explained, and the guard finds where it belongs

e_set_dawn.gift: the lost wing's nine windows, seen from the street she walks to school

e_win_secret_workshop.gift: the founder's hidden workshop and a singing brass wren as proof

e_win_night_guard.gift: Pym and Nadia open the stair he hunted for thirty-one years together

e_win_mystery_solved.gift: the whole truth: Ellery was not a thief and the treasures go home

e_win_quiet_keeper.gift: Nadia keeps the secret and steers the curator to the globe herself

e_win_lost_wing.gift: the lost wing reopened to the town through Nadia's photographs

e_win_founders_door.gift: the founder's garden door, opened by the key and the joined map

e_win_owl_witness.gift: the owl speaks for Ellery and wins the curator over

e_win_hero_curator.gift: the curator reads the letter and Ellery's name is cleared

e_win_secret_kept.gift: a shared secret with Tess, a password and a rota

e_win_donate.gift: the room found by the museum, credited to a nameless curious visitor

e_neutral_call_home.gift: a safe call home and a guard eager to hear the whole story

e_neutral_evidence.gift: photographs that send the curator straight for her keys

e_neutral_wiser.gift: a careful list of the room and a curator who believes a shelf that counts
